A: supplied Python reference demonstrates contracts. row_totals O(number of cells plus rows), may be O(r*c) for rectangular non-empty grids; independent rows via [[0 for ...] for ...]. Binary search O(log n) comparisons under precondition; sorting/maintaining data adds cost. Any duplicate-match index acceptable. Insertion best O(n) comparisons, worst O(n^2); strict > makes provided sort stable. Typical selection swaps can be unstable; bubble adjacent swaps can be stable with strict comparisons; early-exit behaviour depends on implementation. Shallow sorted copy preserves original list order but shares objects. Session methods reject bad/full input; direct attribute mutation and concurrent booking aren't protected by this model. Polymorphic output Room,Online,Outdoor for relevant objects.
